name: cordis-plugin-development
title_zh: 开发、调试、回滚 Cordis 插件的一站式技能
tagline_zh: 写插件卡在 Host Service 或事件上？它帮你定位到正确的 Provider，改完能跑、坏了能回滚。
tagline_en: Stuck on Host Services or events? It routes you to the right provider, runs, repairs, or rolls back—even handles.
desc_en: Create, modify, debug, or extend dynamic Cordis Plugins, including Host Services and Events, Client Slot and theme UI, Package-private Client-to-Host calls, dynamic Tools, version updates, approval failures, and runtime diagnostics. Use this Skill to route a user request to the correct platform and Inspect Provider, then define, run, repair, or roll back the Plugin.
why_zh: 不只是生成代码——它把请求路由到正确的平台和 Inspect Provider，再定义、运行。
why_en: Not just codegen—it routes requests to the right platform and Inspect Provider, then defines, runs, repairs, or rolls back in a.
limit_zh: 仅限 Cordis 插件开发，且需已有 pilot-harness 环境；不覆盖非 Cordis 项目。
limit_en: Cordis plugins only, requires pilot-harness env; no non-Cordis projects, output stops at plugin code, no deployment.
